incorrect_field_in_original.original_note: The original adjudication record sets anchor_ci_completed_utc equal to the PR #158 merge timestamp (2026-09-21T17:09:25Z). This conflates merge time with CI completion time.
incorrect_field_in_original.error: The anchor CI workflows completed after the PR merge time. Two required workflows ran on anchor commit 56c73f0b0533cb0348076efd02c9a654d7243c20 (PR #158 merge commit). Their last job completion timestamps, obtained from the GitHub Actions API, are later than the merge timestamp. Setting anchor_ci_completed_utc to the merge timestamp understates the time between anchor CI completion and first repetition start.

corrected_chronology.anchor_ci_completed_utc_basis: Latest of the two required workflow last-job completion timestamps. Both workflows were required to be green before repetition.

chronology_consistency_with_correction.gap_computation: From 2026-09-21T17:10:55Z (anchor CI completed) to 2026-09-21T17:15:30.835331Z (first repetition started) = 4 minutes 35.8 seconds ≈ 275 seconds.
chronology_consistency_with_correction.interpretation: The corrected chronology confirms that both required CI workflows completed successfully on the anchor commit before the first repetition attempt began. The prior record's statement 'chronology_consistent=true' remains correct; only the anchor_ci_completed_utc value used in that determination was imprecise.
chronology_consistency_with_correction.prior_minor_inconsistency_note: The original adjudication record also noted a minor discrepancy in the transition timestamp (CSH-TRANSITION-20260921-REPEAT-ATTEMPTED-BROWNOUT at 17:15:15Z vs. actual start 17:15:30Z). That observation is preserved unchanged; the ~15 second discrepancy is unaffected by this chronology correction.

what_does_not_change: The gate decision BLOCKED_RECEIVER_RETIRED is unchanged.
All factual determinations in the original adjudication record are unchanged.
The anchor CI requirement (both Cross-System Claim Handoff v0.1 and Fork Proof-Surface Integration green) was satisfied; this correction updates only the recorded timestamp for when it was satisfied.
